verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented capability for user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur, and this is a fair axis for an AI assistant/agent product. The help center lists scheduled tasks (定时任务), but these are time-based recurring schedules rather than event-triggered rules, and the IDE mention of "automated tasks" does not describe event triggers, hooks, or rule definitions, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
